Among these, fcc HEAs exhibit broad application prospects due to their exceptional combination of strength and ductility, high wear resistance and outstanding potential for use in extreme environments.
However, the inherent structural characteristics of the fcc lattice often result in low yield strengths, which significantly limits the practical engineering applications of fcc HEAs.
For instance, twinninginduced plasticity (TWIP) and/or transformation-induced plasticity (TRIP) effects have been introduced by reducing the stacking fault energy (SFE) of fcc HEAs.
